text: Isabel starts at the architecture firm on 3rd of November. She's nervous about the commute but thrilled overall. Her boyfriend is taking the week off to help with their dog while she settles in, which is sweet. She said the first fortnight is mostly training and shadowing, and she gets her own projects after Christmas. Text her good luck the night before.

Victor's retiring at the end of term after thirty-one years teaching chemistry. Leaving do is Friday the 12th at the Crown. He says he's going to spend his time on the allotment and finally learn Portuguese, since his daughter lives in Porto now. His wife thinks he'll be bored within a month. Half the staff room are chipping in for a new greenhouse.
Marta's new puppy arrived this weekend, a cocker spaniel called Biscuit. She's barely slept.
Neha got the promotion! Team lead from January. Must send her a proper congratulations card, not just a WhatsApp.
Pieter said his cat Saffy has kidney trouble and is going in for bloods on Tuesday. He seemed really down about it.
Catch-up with Kate over lunch. Her husband Sean has been made redundant, meeting with HR on 14/11. She asked me not to mention it to the others yet.
Need to pick up dog food and the dry cleaning tomorrow before nine.
Suzanne mentioned she'd love one of those heated throws for the sofa. Good shout for her birthday on 2 December.
Layla and Ali are moving to Leeds sometime in the spring, once his transfer goes through. Their kids are not happy about changing schools.
Fiona's mum had her hip operation yesterday. All went fine apparently. I should ring Fiona on Thursday to see how her mum's getting on.
Alina had her first day at the bank on Monday. Says everyone's friendly but the systems are a nightmare. Ask her how week two went.
Kiara's 30th has been cancelled because her dad's unwell. She's going to do something small after Christmas instead.
Archie, or Arch as everyone at football calls him, is leaving for a job in Dubai in a fortnight. Organise something with the lads before he goes.
Catalina's dog Pepa turns ten on 8th of December. She's planning a little party with dog cake, which is very her.
Hemi is vegetarian and doesn't drink. Worth remembering for the Christmas meal.

Keisha is waiting to hear back about the head of department role. Interview was last Wednesday and they said they'd let her know soon. Message her next week if I haven't heard anything. She's been acting head for most of this year, so it'd be a real blow if they gave it to an outside candidate. Her husband says she's checking her email every ten minutes.
Theo's sister Mabel is expecting her first baby in March. Theo is going to be an uncle and can't stop talking about it.
Bumped into Tendai at the station. He's started a part-time course in carpentry and loves it. Wants to build his own shed eventually.
Mei's rabbit died last night. She'd had him eight years. Send her something small, maybe flowers, on Friday.
Eli's last day at the council is 31 October. He's going freelance. Leaving drinks are that evening, I'm going straight from work.
Aoife said the vet thinks her cat might need a tooth out. Appointment is next Tuesday at 4.
Imani and her partner are getting a puppy sometime next month. They've been reading training books for weeks. She's slightly terrified.
Ioana phoned about the hen do. It's 22nd–24th May in Lisbon. I said yes and I'm booking flights tonight.

Long call with Lila. Her new manager is micromanaging everything and she's dreading going in each morning. She's had two rejections from other jobs this month too, which hasn't helped. I said we'd get coffee this weekend and I really must follow through, she sounded flat. Also, her brother Thabo is starting at Bristol uni next September, which she's proud of.
Xavier's starting as a junior doctor in Glasgow on 6 August. He's moving up there at the end of July.
Elena told me she's allergic to cats, so the dinner at mine needs rethinking. She's coming on the 15th.
Victor mentioned his wife Isabel is retiring too, probably in the summer. They want to do a big trip to New Zealand afterwards.
Don't forget to sign Neha's leaving card before Thursday. It's in Marta's drawer.
Pieter texted: Saffy's bloods came back okay, no kidney disease after all. Huge relief all round.
Kate's son started nursery this week and cried every single morning. She's finding it harder than he is, honestly.
Sean got the job at the brewery! He starts on the 1st. Remind me to buy him a decent bottle of something to celebrate.
Suzanne's been off work with her back since last Monday. Physio on Wednesday. I should check in with her at the weekend.
Ali mentioned he's training for the Great North Run in September. Already doing 10k on Sundays.

Fiona's dog Murphy went missing on Saturday and turned up at a farm two miles away on Sunday night. Muddy but fine. Fiona was in bits all weekend, she'd been round every field with a torch and put posts up everywhere. The farmer recognised him from the Facebook group and rang her. She's getting him microchip details updated on Monday and a GPS collar soon, she said.
Kiara's dad has his scan on 19th of November. She's going with him. She's been really anxious all week.
Met Alina's partner, Hemi Nowak, at the quiz. Lovely guy, works in IT for the NHS, mad about rugby.
Need to book the car in for its MOT sometime before the end of the month.
Keisha got it! Head of department from after half term. Send congrats tonight.
Theo and Catalina are celebrating their tenth anniversary on 14 February. He wants to surprise her with a weekend in Rome and asked me to keep her free.
Emily's started volunteering at the animal shelter on Saturday mornings. She's thinking of fostering a cat in the new year.
Tendai's grandmother passed away on Sunday. Funeral is in Harare next week, so he'll be off work until the 28th. Message him tomorrow, just to say I'm thinking of him.
Coffee with Mei. She's applying for a master's in landscape design, deadline 15/01. Her budgie Kiwi is now a year old, apparently.
Eli is having a bit of a wobble about going freelance. Only one client lined up so far. He'll be fine, I think.
Mabel Shah's baby shower is on Sunday the 9th at her mum's. Bring something from the list, ideally the bath thermometer.
Aoife's cat had the tooth out. Recovering well, eating already. Ask Aoife on Friday whether the stitches are holding up.
Imani mentioned her brother Xavier is getting married next summer, date to be confirmed. She's maid of honour, sort of, they're calling it best woman.
Ioana's interview for the curator post is on Thursday at 10. She's prepared loads but always gets nervous. Text her good luck Wednesday night, and then ask how it went on Friday.
Lila loves hiking and is into wild swimming lately. Mentioned a dry robe would be a dream present.
Thabo's football team made it to the county final on 30 November. Thabo's playing in goal.
Dentist moved to next Monday, 9:15.
Xavier's dad, Dr Chen, is retiring from the practice after Christmas. There's a party for him sometime in January, I think.
Elena got a kitten despite the allergies. Named her Olive. Says the antihistamines are working, mostly.
Isabel's first week went well. Her boss already asked her to lead a small project, which is a good sign. She's also planning to adopt a greyhound once she's settled, probably in the spring.
Marta's puppy Biscuit has his second jabs on 4th of November, then he can finally go out for walks. Marta can't wait. Remind me to offer to dog-sit when she goes to her sister's wedding on the 20th.

Emily's not doing great. Her contract ends on Friday and nothing lined up yet, plus her mum's moving in with them for a few weeks while her kitchen's redone. She said she's applied for a few things and has a phone interview on Wednesday, but she sounded exhausted. Call her on Sunday afternoon.

Victor's leaving do was lovely. Gave a very funny speech. He's already booked a cruise for March. Isabel cried during the speech, so did half the room. His old students sent a video from all over the world. I should print a couple of the photos I took and send them to him next week.

Spent the afternoon with Neha and Kate planning Suzanne's surprise 50th. It's on Saturday 7 March, at the cricket club. Kate's handling the cake, Neha's doing invites, and I'm on decorations. Suzanne's husband Pieter will get her there by pretending it's a dinner with his boss. We still need to decide on a band, and Neha thinks her cousin's group might do it cheaply. Need to email the club by Friday to confirm numbers.

Archie's flight to Dubai is on the 3rd at 7am. His mum is struggling with him going, she keeps saying it's only two years but she was teary when I saw her at the shop. His girlfriend Keisha is staying here for now and flying out to visit in April. Must pop round to see her sometime the week after.
Hemi's thinking about going for the senior role that comes up in the new year. Hasn't decided yet.
Quiet one today. Walked to the river, did the food shop, finally sorted the spare room.
